quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **103:0.** بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ — Birincil okuma: Açılış besmelesi, sûreyi Allah’ın yükseltilmiş adı ve merhamet bağı altında başlatan bir yetkilendirme sözüdür. Sonraki yemin, kayıp ve istisna bu okumayı değiştirir: merhamet yalnızca başlangıç duası değil, insanı hüsrandan çıkaracak karşılıklı vasiyet ve dayanışmanın rahim gibi koruyan zemini hâline gelir. {س م و B005; ء ل ه B002; ر ح م B001; ر ح م B002; ر ح م B003; و ص ي B003; ص ب ر B003; ح ق ق B005}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Açılış besmelesi, sûreyi Allah’ın yükseltilmiş adı ve merhamet bağı altında başlatan bir yetkilendirme sözüdür. Sonraki yemin, kayıp ve istisna bu okumayı değiştirir: merhamet yalnızca başlangıç duası değil, insanı hüsrandan çıkaracak karşılıklı vasiyet ve dayanışmanın rahim gibi koruyan zemini hâline gelir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **103:1.** وَٱلْعَصْرِ — Birincil okuma: Asr, insanın eksilişini görünür kılan tekrar eden zaman üzerine yoğun bir yemindir. Bağlam bunu şaşırtıcı biçimde genişletir: asr yalnız nötr zaman değil, hayatı sıkan bir pres, zarar veya verim çıkaran bir imtihan, aynı zamanda sığınılacak bağ ihtiyacını doğuran basınç ve hatta rahmet yağmurunu taşıyan sıkışmış bulut imgesi olarak da okunur. {ع ص ر B001; ع ص ر B002; ع ص ر B003; ع ص ر B005; ع ص ر B007; خ س ر B001; خ س ر B002; ع م ل B004; و ص ي B003; س م و B004}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Asr, insanın eksilişini görünür kılan tekrar eden zaman üzerine yoğun bir yemindir. Bağlam bunu şaşırtıcı biçimde genişletir: asr yalnız nötr zaman değil, hayatı sıkan bir pres, zarar veya verim çıkaran bir imtihan, aynı zamanda sığınılacak bağ ihtiyacını doğuran basınç ve hatta rahmet yağmurunu taşıyan sıkışmış bulut imgesi olarak da okunur.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **103:2.** إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ — Birincil okuma: İnsan, zaman içinde açıkça görünen genel bir eksilme ve hüsran hâlinin içindedir. Sonraki istisna bu hükmü yalnız bireysel bir mahkûmiyet olmaktan çıkarır: hüsran ticari zarar, eksik ölçü, ödenmemiş hak, bozulan algı ve yalnızlaşmış insanlık olarak belirir; çıkış ise başka bir toplumsal tutunma ve sabır kabına girmektir. {ء ن س B001; ء ن س B002; ء ن س B003; خ س ر B001; خ س ر B002; خ س ر B003; خ س ر B005; ع ص ر B002; ح ق ق B002; ح ق ق B003; ص ب ر B001}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: İnsan, zaman içinde açıkça görünen genel bir eksilme ve hüsran hâlinin içindedir. Sonraki istisna bu hükmü yalnız bireysel bir mahkûmiyet olmaktan çıkarır: hüsran ticari zarar, eksik ölçü, ödenmemiş hak, bozulan algı ve yalnızlaşmış insanlık olarak belirir; çıkış ise başka bir toplumsal tutunma ve sabır kabına girmektir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **103:3.** إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ — Birincil okuma: İstisna edilenler iman eden, salih işler yapan, hakkı ve sabrı birbirine tavsiye eden topluluktur. Önceki ayetler bu diziyi şaşırtıcı biçimde bir erdem listesi olmaktan çıkarır: güven kalbi sabitler, iş ve salihlik bozuk yapıyı onarır, hak eksik ölçüyü düzeltir, karşılıklı vasiyet bu hakkı dolaşımda tutar, sabır ise baskı, acılık ve zor şartlar altında bu yapıyı taşıyan dayanıklı kenar hâline gelir. {ء م ن B001; ء م ن B002; ع م ل B001; ع م ل B004; ص ل ح B001; و ص ي B001; و ص ي B002; و ص ي B003; ح ق ق B001; ح ق ق B002; ح ق ق B010; ص ب ر B001; ص ب ر B005; ص ب ر B008}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: İstisna edilenler iman eden, salih işler yapan, hakkı ve sabrı birbirine tavsiye eden topluluktur. Önceki ayetler bu diziyi şaşırtıcı biçimde bir erdem listesi olmaktan çıkarır: güven kalbi sabitler, iş ve salihlik bozuk yapıyı onarır, hak eksik ölçüyü düzeltir, karşılıklı vasiyet bu hakkı dolaşımda tutar, sabır ise baskı, acılık ve zor şartlar altında bu yapıyı taşıyan dayanıklı kenar hâline gelir.

parent_channels.name: Truthful Commitment Against Loss

subchannels.name: Conviction Realized as Sound Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person assents to truth, turns that assent into deliberate good action, and thereby opposes loss with soundness.
subchannels.active_motifs: faithful submission to truth `ء م ن:B002/m02`; truth opposed to falsehood `ح ق ق:B001/m01`; morally qualified intentional deed `ع م ل:B001/m02`; soundness opposed to corruption `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; general diminishment `خ س ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Conviction is not left as an inward state. It is matched to what is true, embodied in intended deeds, and expressed as a movement from corruption or decrease toward soundness.

subchannels.name: Reciprocal Counsel as Communal Steadiness
subchannels.scene_or_process: People repeatedly counsel one another while trust, companionship, and self-restraint keep the group from dispersing under pressure.
subchannels.active_motifs: reciprocal counsel `و ص ي:B003/m01`; self-restraint against panic `ص ب ر:B001/m01`; steadfast endurance `ص ب ر:B001/m02`; companionship removing estrangement `ء ن س:B003/m01`; settled security and trust `ء م ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Mutual counsel becomes a sustaining social practice rather than a one-way instruction. Familiar presence removes isolation, trust stabilizes relations, and patience supplies the inward restraint needed for counsel to persist.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human diminishment is countered when conviction, truth, purposeful action, and communal steadiness remain aligned.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 103:2 names the human being in `خُسْرٍ`, while 103:3 answers with `ءَامَنُوا۟`, `عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ`, and reciprocal counsel in `ٱلْحَقِّ` and `ٱلصَّبْرِ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The ethical sequence opens into a social mechanism in which trusted companionship helps a community hold its course.

parent_channels.name: Entrusted Rights and Enforcement

subchannels.name: Testament, Executor, and Surety
subchannels.scene_or_process: A binding instruction is transmitted to another person, placed under an executor, and secured by obligation and guarantee.
subchannels.active_motifs: transmitted charge `و ص ي:B002/m01`; testament after death `و ص ي:B002/m02`; appointed executor `و ص ي:B002/m03`; surety or guarantor `ص ب ر:B003/m01`; binding obligation `ح ق ق:B002/m01`; proprietary right `ح ق ق:B003/m01`; appointment to office `ع م ل:B003/m02`; protected charge requiring defense `ح ق ق:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene joins message, office, property, and person. A charge remains effective because someone is designated to carry it, a guarantor stands behind it, and the right itself imposes a duty of protection.

subchannels.name: Contested Right Reconciled by Deliberation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opposing claimants each assert a right; reciprocal communication and adjudication convert the contest into restored concord.
subchannels.active_motifs: adversarial rights dispute `ح ق ق:B004/m01`; adjudication and verification `ح ق ق:B005/m02`; peacemaking `ص ل ح:B002/m01`; restored social concord `ص ل ح:B002/m02`; reciprocal communication `و ص ي:B003/m02`; human collective `ء ن س:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The dispute is not erased but processed. Competing claims are stated and tested, communication remains reciprocal, and reconciliation removes the estrangement generated by the contest.

subchannels.name: Coercive Custody and Compelled Oath
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or living target is externally held, prevented from leaving, and in one legal extension forced to swear.
subchannels.active_motifs: restraint and withholding `ع ص ر:B006/m01`; captive held for execution `ص ب ر:B002/m01`; living target held for shooting `ص ب ر:B002/m02`; oath compelled by authority `ص ب ر:B002/m03`; human person `ء ن س:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The voluntary holding of patience is reversed into externally imposed holding. Custody fixes a body in place, while the compelled oath fixes speech under institutional pressure.

subchannels.name: Requital Satisfying a Claim
subchannels.scene_or_process: An established entitlement is answered by exact retaliation or an execution carried out under authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: exacting retaliation `ص ب ر:B012/m01`; execution by requital `ص ب ر:B012/m02`; established entitlement `ح ق ق:B002/m02`; incurred loss `خ س ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Loss becomes a claim that demands a proportionate answer. The lexical scene moves from deprivation to a formally satisfied right, with authority converting the claim into requital.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A binding claim is carried through appointed roles, contested speech, reconciliation, custody, or requital.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 103:3 supplies the anchors `ٱلْحَقِّ`, `تَوَاصَوْا۟`, `عَمِلُوا۟`, and `ٱلصَّبْرِ`, whose lexical branches extend into legal and fiduciary relations.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Reciprocal exhortation expands into testamentary succession, surety, compelled testimony, and authoritative requital.

parent_channels.name: Work, Exchange, and Accounted Return

subchannels.name: Labor Crew and Earned Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Manual workers perform material tasks and receive a wage or extracted yield whose absence would constitute loss.
subchannels.active_motifs: manual laboring crew `ع م ل:B006/m01`; digging and building labor `ع م ل:B006/m02`; wage or provision `ع م ل:B004/m01`; extracted yield or revenue `ع ص ر:B007/m02`; entitlement to return `ح ق ق:B002/m02`; general loss `خ س ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Work is organized as a crew-based productive process. Effort produces a claim to wages and yield, so diminution is legible as the failure of labor to receive its due return.

subchannels.name: Transaction, Capital, and the Hard Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dealing places capital and proprietary claims at risk, ending either in retained value or an unprofitable return.
subchannels.active_motifs: interpersonal transaction `ع م ل:B005/m01`; capital loss or absence of profit `خ س ر:B002/m01`; proprietary claim `ح ق ق:B003/m01`; gift entering circulation `ع ص ر:B007/m01`; coarse hard stone `ص ب ر:B005/m01`; bitter medicinal extract `ص ب ر:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The commercial frame joins dealing, ownership, transfer, and the possibility of losing principal. Hard stone and bitter extract provide sensory analogues for a bargain whose return is resistant and unpleasant.

subchannels.name: Pressed Yield and Short Measure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material is put through a press, collected as extract, then assessed by measure; an underfilled scale converts production into loss.
subchannels.active_motifs: pressure-based extraction `ع ص ر:B002/m01`; juice or expressed yield `ع ص ر:B002/m03`; putting a tool to use `ع م ل:B002/m02`; deficient measure or weight `خ س ر:B003/m01`; unmeasured bulk-food sale `ص ب ر:B011/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Pressing transforms raw material into a countable return. The heap sold without weighing and the deliberately reduced measure expose the point at which productive extraction becomes quantitative deprivation.

subchannels.name: Withheld Property and Recoverable Shortfall
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property or benefit is withheld, reclaimed, or taken back, leaving the other party with a measurable decrease.
subchannels.active_motifs: withholding benefit `ع ص ر:B006/m01`; reclaiming property or revoking a gift `ع ص ر:B006/m02`; miserly retention of good `ع ص ر:B006/m03`; short measure `خ س ر:B003/m01`; general decrease `خ س ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Loss is produced here by arrested circulation. Goods that should pass are withheld or recovered, and the resulting shortage appears either as diminished quantity or as the absence of expected benefit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Labor or property is evaluated by the return it yields, the right it creates, and the measure by which gain or shortfall is known.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 103:2 states `خُسْرٍ` and 103:3 states `عَمِلُوا۟`, establishing the loss-work axis that the lexical scenes specify economically.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Failed return acquires the tactile hardness of gravel and the bitterness of medicinal sap, while quantitative loss becomes an underfilled measure.

parent_channels.name: Maturation, Fitness, and Provision

subchannels.name: Maturity into Working Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A young person or animal crosses a developmental threshold and becomes physically ready for adult or load-bearing activity.
subchannels.active_motifs: girl reaching youth or puberty `ع ص ر:B009/m01`; camel reaching carrying and riding age `ح ق ق:B008/m01`; breeding maturity `ح ق ق:B008/m02`; capable working camel `ع م ل:B008/m02`; strengthened animal condition `ح ق ق:B014/m02`; attained soundness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Maturity is defined functionally rather than merely chronologically. Growth culminates when the body can carry, reproduce, travel, or work with the soundness expected of its completed state.

subchannels.name: Suitable Pasture and Full Animal Condition
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pasture fits the grazing animal, abundant feeding brings it to full condition, and reliability makes it usable.
subchannels.active_motifs: pasture suited to livestock `و ص ي:B004/m01`; abundance reaching the grazing animal `و ص ي:B004/m02`; practical suitability `ص ل ح:B003/m01`; livestock reaching full fat condition `ح ق ق:B013/m01`; dependable working animal `ء م ن:B001/m04`; care improving an animal `ص ل ح:B001/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Fitness emerges from a match between setting and participant. Suitable pasture supplies abundance, care and feeding complete the animal's condition, and that bodily completion becomes dependable service.

subchannels.name: Encased Crop and Piled Food
subchannels.scene_or_process: Grain is protected in its husk, gathered onto a broad food layer, and accumulated into a heap filled to its boundary.
subchannels.active_motifs: crop enclosed in husks `ع ص ر:B010/m01`; broad layer beneath food `ص ب ر:B011/m01`; stacked food heap `ص ب ر:B011/m02`; filling to the brim `ص ب ر:B004/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Natural enclosure precedes human accumulation. The husk guards the crop while it grows; afterward the broad support, heap, and filled edge organize it as stored provision.

subchannels.name: Tree, Sour Fruit, and Bitter Sap
subchannels.scene_or_process: A named tree bears or yields sharply flavored plant products that become food or medicine.
subchannels.active_motifs: named tree `ع ص ر:B013/m01`; sour tamarind-like fruit and red seed `ص ب ر:B009/m01`; bitter aloe extract used as medicine `ص ب ر:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The plant scene gathers trunk, fruit, seed, and extracted sap. Sourness and bitterness distinguish edible produce from medicinal yield while preserving their common botanical source.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A living being or food source becomes usable when it reaches maturity, receives fitting conditions, and is protected or accumulated.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: One readiness threshold spans adolescent growth, a camel's carrying age, a work animal's stamina, pasture suitability, crop enclosure, and stored food.

parent_channels.name: Holding Under Pressure

subchannels.name: Steadfastness Through Ordeal and Toil
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person restrains panic and continues through an inescapable crisis, severe cold, toil, or a pace that exceeds ordinary strength.
subchannels.active_motifs: self-restraint against panic `ص ب ر:B001/m01`; steadfast endurance `ص ب ر:B001/m02`; inescapable ordeal `ص ب ر:B006/m01`; severe winter cold `ص ب ر:B007/m01`; punishing pace exhausting the back `ح ق ق:B012/m01`; burden beyond the weak person's capacity `ح ق ق:B012/m02`; strenuous effort `ع م ل:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Patience is rendered as controlled continuation under conditions that offer neither comfort nor an easy exit. Cold, forced pace, and toil make the internal act of holding oneself physically legible.

subchannels.name: Security Through Refuge and Attachment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A threatened person reaches safety by taking hold of a refuge or a protective relationship.
subchannels.active_motifs: refuge and deliverance `ع ص ر:B005/m01`; taking hold of shelter `ع ص ر:B005/m02`; attachment through affection or kinship `ع ص ر:B005/m03`; granted safety against fear `ء م ن:B001/m02`; loyal attendant remaining with the group `ص ب ر:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Safety is both spatial and relational. Refuge provides a place of deliverance, while kinship, affection, and a companion who remains with the group bind the vulnerable person to continuing protection.

subchannels.name: Straight Penetration and Inescapable Harm
subchannels.scene_or_process: A spear's forepart carries a straight thrust into the body, producing a calamity from which there is no clear exit.
subchannels.active_motifs: spear forepart near the point `ع م ل:B009/m01`; straight penetrating thrust `ح ق ق:B009/m01`; inescapable calamity `ص ب ر:B006/m01`; ruin or destruction `خ س ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Tool component, trajectory, penetration, and outcome form one harm mechanism. The shaft aligns the point, the thrust does not glance aside, and bodily penetration becomes the concrete realization of ruin.

subchannels.name: Thirst, Choking, and Incremental Relief
subchannels.scene_or_process: A parched or choking person takes water in small increments until the obstructed swallow is released.
subchannels.active_motifs: tongue dried by thirst `ع ص ر:B014/m01`; small sips clearing a choking obstruction `ع ص ر:B008/m01`; bitter medicinal extract `ص ب ر:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Dryness and blockage define the bodily crisis, while measured drinking supplies the release mechanism. Bitter medicine extends the scene from immediate relief to a deliberately endured remedy.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Pressure is answered by inward restraint, protective attachment, bodily relief, or the failure to escape harm.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 103:3 explicitly names `ٱلصَّبْرِ`, while 103:2 supplies the adverse outcome `خُسْرٍ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral steadfastness is mirrored by exhausting travel, refuge, penetrating injury, severe cold, and the small drink that releases a blocked throat.

parent_channels.name: Linked Time and Inherited Belonging

subchannels.name: Joined Spans of Time
subchannels.scene_or_process: Time proceeds through adjoining eras and the repeated joining of night to day, with afternoon marking a situated interval.
subchannels.active_motifs: era or span of time `ع ص ر:B001/m01`; alternating day and night `ع ص ر:B001/m02`; afternoon or evening interval `ع ص ر:B001/m03`; delayed or untimely arrival `ع ص ر:B001/m04`; joining one thing to another `و ص ي:B001/m01`; continuity of night and day `و ص ي:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Time is pictured as connected intervals rather than an empty container. Day joins night, one era succeeds another, and even delay is understood by where an arrival falls within that linked sequence.

subchannels.name: Lineage, Clan, and Affiliation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human group traces itself back to ancestral stock and locates members through clan and client relationships.
subchannels.active_motifs: ancestral origin and lineage `ع ص ر:B011/m01`; noble stock `ع ص ر:B011/m02`; Ghassan clan `ص ب ر:B016/m01`; subordinate client affiliation `ع ص ر:B012/m01`; human collective `ء ن س:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Belonging is structured by return to an origin. Lineage provides the backward path, clan gives it a collective body, and clientship marks a lower but still connected position within the social chain.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Continuity joins adjacent spans and carries collective identity through lineage, clan, and affiliation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 103:1 `عَصْرِ` directly supplies temporal extent, while the joining sense behind 103:3 `تَوَاصَوْا۟` extends continuity into relation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The succession of day and night becomes an analogue for ancestry, noble stock, clan membership, and subordinate alliance.

parent_channels.name: Perception and Human-Facing Alignment

subchannels.name: Sensing, Assent, and Verification
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person detects something by sight, sound, or inward sensation, then confirms it as a trustworthy report or established truth.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual apprehension `ء ن س:B002/m01`; auditory apprehension `ء ن س:B002/m02`; inward sensing `ء ن س:B002/m03`; deliberate inspection `ء ن س:B002/m04`; confirmation of report or promise `ء م ن:B002/m01`; establishment of truth by proof `ح ق ق:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Perception supplies several entrances into one verification process. What is seen, heard, or felt is inspected, accepted as credible, and finally made manifest through proof.

subchannels.name: The Human Image in the Eye
subchannels.scene_or_process: The eye receives a person as a small reflected figure in its dark center while the organ performs its active visual work.
subchannels.active_motifs: pupil or reflected human image `ء ن س:B005/m01`; active eye as a working organ `ع م ل:B010/m02`; visible human figure `ء ن س:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The perceiver and perceived person meet inside the pupil. The human figure becomes both optical object and image, while the working eye supplies the bodily mechanism that holds it.

subchannels.name: Rider, Bow, Spear, and Working Limbs
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mount or bow presents a human-facing side, limbs generate action, and the spear's forepart is aligned toward its use.
subchannels.active_motifs: human-facing side of mount or bow `ء ن س:B004/m01`; spear forepart `ع م ل:B009/m01`; working legs or limbs `ع م ل:B010/m01`; horse matching hind hoof to forehoof track `ح ق ق:B014/m01`; enclosing or oriented side `ص ب ر:B004/m02`; joined components `و ص ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Orientation is defined relative to an operator. Near side, limb, hoof track, shaft, and joining relation assemble a coordinated human-animal-tool system in which facing and fit determine effective action.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A human perceiver is oriented by what can be sensed, reflected, faced, or aligned for action.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 103:2 names `إِنسَٰنَ`, and 103:3 joins assent to `ٱلْحَقِّ`, while the optical and mechanical scenes remain lexical.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Recognition through sight and hearing extends into the miniature human image in the pupil and the user-facing geometry of mount, bow, spear, and limbs.

parent_channels.name: Fitted Boundaries and Supporting Centers

subchannels.name: Joint, Socket, and Sealed Vessel
subchannels.scene_or_process: An opening is bounded by sides, receives a matching fitted part, and is closed by a stopper.
subchannels.active_motifs: bottle or vessel stopper `ص ب ر:B018/m01`; fitted container or door socket `ح ق ق:B011/m02`; upper rim `ص ب ر:B004/m01`; enclosing sides `ص ب ر:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Boundary and closure form one mechanism. Sides define the opening, the socket gives a part its proper seat, and the stopper completes containment by occupying that fitted position.

subchannels.name: Articulated and Geographic Centers
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bone joint and a mountain mass are organized around a fitted or central middle.
subchannels.active_motifs: bone articulation or hip socket `ح ق ق:B011/m01`; structural middle or center `ح ق ق:B011/m03`; mountain mass `ص ب ر:B017/m01`; mountain middle `ص ب ر:B017/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The anatomical joint and geographic massif share a center-bearing structure. One joins bodily parts at a socket; the other identifies the middle that organizes a larger mass.

subchannels.name: Tight Weave, Firm Speech, and Worked Material
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material is worked into a compact weave or built form, and speech is analogously composed so that it does not loosen or fail.
subchannels.active_motifs: tightly woven fabric `ح ق ق:B010/m01`; firm and precise speech `ح ق ق:B010/m02`; perfected workmanship `ح ق ق:B010/m03`; material worked in construction `ع م ل:B002/m04`; spider web as fitted mesh `ح ق ق:B011/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Making and saying share a criterion of firmness. Threads or building material are brought into a stable arrangement, while well-composed speech reproduces that cohesion at the level of discourse.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A stable form depends on enclosing edges, matching sockets, central support, or material worked into a firm structure.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same geometry connects vessel stoppers, bodily joints, a mountain's middle, woven cloth, firm speech, and a spider's web.

parent_channels.name: Named Persons, Places, and Groups

subchannels.name: Named Person and Intimate Circle
subchannels.scene_or_process: A named individual is socially located through a selected confidant and close companion.
subchannels.active_motifs: person named Salih `ص ل ح:B004/m01`; related personal names `ص ل ح:B004/m02`; chosen intimate or confidant `ء ن س:B006/m02`; close companion `ء ن س:B006/m03`; trustworthy person `ء م ن:B001/m05`
subchannels.synthesis: Personal identity is not only a label but a social position. The proper name identifies the person, while confidants and trusted companions define the immediate circle around that identity.

subchannels.name: City and River Names
subchannels.scene_or_process: Root-derived names attach to distinct geographic entities, one urban or sacred and one fluvial.
subchannels.active_motifs: Salah as a name for Mecca `ص ل ح:B005/m01`; al-Sulh as a river in Maysan `ص ل ح:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: A single lexical family maps onto two kinds of place. The name fixes identity at city scale in one use and along a river course in another.

subchannels.name: Clan and Noble Stock
subchannels.scene_or_process: A named descent group locates its members within inherited social stock.
subchannels.active_motifs: Ghassan clan `ص ب ر:B016/m01`; noble ancestral stock `ع ص ر:B011/m02`; personal self within a close group `ء ن س:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The clan name gives collective identity, noble stock supplies inherited standing, and the individual self is positioned inside that descent-based group.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A lexical name locates identity by attaching it to a person, an intimate circle, a place, or inherited stock.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The naming frame moves from a person called Salih to confidants, Mecca, a river in Maysan, and noble clan descent.

parent_channels.name: Cloud and Moving Air

subchannels.name: Layered Rain-Bearing Cloud
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moisture-bearing cloud or wind gathers into white layers and releases rain over people and land.
subchannels.active_motifs: rain-bearing cloud or wind `ع ص ر:B003/m01`; rainfall reaching a people `ع ص ر:B003/m02`; white cloud mass `ص ب ر:B010/m01`; cloud stacked in layers `ص ب ر:B010/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Carriage, accumulation, and release form a complete weather process. Moisture is borne aloft, cloud layers build upon one another, and rain is delivered from the accumulated mass.

subchannels.name: Whirlwind, Dust Column, and Trailing Air
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rotating air lifts dust into a column or draws fragrance behind a moving garment, with bodily wind providing a smaller internal analogue.
subchannels.active_motifs: whirlwind `ع ص ر:B004/m01`; rotating dust column `ع ص ر:B004/m02`; trailing fragrance wake `ع ص ر:B004/m03`; bodily wind `ع ص ر:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The common operation is air made visible by what it carries. Dust reveals rotation, fragrance reveals a wake, and the bodily extension compresses release and movement into an internal scale.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Air carries, layers, lifts, or releases suspended matter such as rain, cloud, dust, and fragrance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Atmospheric circulation reaches from stacked rain cloud to a rotating dust column, a trailing scent, and the body's own release of wind.

parent_channels.name: S1. Foot Travelers on a Worked Road
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Human travelers cross hard terrain on foot along a route made clear by repeated use.
parent_channels.active_motifs: human collective `ء ن س:B001/m01`; walking travelers `ع م ل:B012/m01`; well-traveled road `ع م ل:B011/m01`; gravelly hard terrain `ص ب ر:B005/m02`; mountain mass `ص ب ر:B017/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Participant, mode of travel, path, and terrain form a complete journey scene. Repeated passage works the route into visibility, while the mountain and gravel explain why travel proceeds on a constrained, durable track.

parent_channels.name: S2. Invocation Seeking a Response
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A speaker says Amen at the close of prayer in order to request acceptance and realization.
parent_channels.active_motifs: utterance of Amen `ء م ن:B003/m01`; request for response or fulfillment `ء م ن:B003/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: The spoken formula links human petition to an anticipated answer. Its force lies not in description but in requesting that what has been prayed for be accepted and brought about.
